items_all.title: China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies
items_all.summary: China plans to restrict exports of 23 key AI technologies, including model weights, source code, and training methods for systems hitting 10^26 FLOPs or 2 trillion parameters. A fast-track rule will still clear open-source releases as soon as they are registered, but the move will likely push Western companies to double down on US open-weight models over Chinese alternatives. The article China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 中國計畫限制 23 項關鍵人工智慧技術的出口，包含算力達到 10^26 FLOPs 或參數達到 2 兆的系統之模型權重、原始碼與訓練方法。一項快速通道規則仍將在開源版本註冊後立即予以放行，但此舉很可能會促使西方企業加倍押注美國的開源權重模型，而非中國的替代方案。這篇文章《China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies》首次發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months
items_all.summary: Google Deepmind's Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, making Google the second lab after OpenAI to cross the 95 percent mark. But the results swing wildly depending on the test setup: in the standard harness, the score drops to just 49.8 percent. Argon also trails rivals in math and software engineering. The article Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 的 Gemini 4 Argon 在 ARC-AGI-3 基準測試中獲得 97.5% 的分數，這使 Google 成為繼 OpenAI 之後第二個突破 95% 門檻的實驗室。但測試結果會根據測試設定而大幅波動：在標準測試框架中，分數暴跌至僅 49.8%。Argon 在數學和軟體工程方面也落後於競爭對手。這篇名為《Google's Gemini 4 Argon 比數月來任何 Google 模型都更接近 AI 前沿》的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Is AI interpretability close to a breakthrough? A new essay has researchers divided
items_all.summary: Neural networks may be much easier to read than researchers assumed, with about 90 percent of neurons serving a clear function. That would be big news for AI safety research, since deception or dangerous behavior could be spotted directly in a model's circuits. Researchers are still debating whether the thesis holds up. The article Is AI interpretability close to a breakthrough? A new essay has researchers divided appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 神經網路可能比研究人員原本假設的更容易解讀，大約有 90% 的神經元具有明確的功能。這對 AI 安全研究來說會是一大好消息，因為欺騙或危險行為可以直接在模型的電路中被發現。研究人員仍在爭論這個論點是否站得住腳。《AI 可解釋性是否接近突破？一篇新論文讓研究人員意見分歧》一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundation model, is about to have […]

items_all.title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
items_all.summary: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.
items_all.summary_zh: 仿冒品製造商在複製品牌標誌以及將稱為「超級仿冒品」的複製品冒充為真品這方面技術越來越好。一家名為 Veritas 的新創公司希望透過其專屬的晶片來解決這個問題，該晶片能驗證商品。

items_all.title: Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index
items_all.summary: Liquid AI released d1-ultra, a text and image decision model that returns calibrated probabilities in 1 forward pass. It scores 65 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index and costs $0.042 per million input tokens. The post Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Liquid AI 發布了 d1-ultra，這是一款文字與圖片決策模型，能在 1 次前向傳遞中返回校準機率。它在 Artificial Analysis 決策指數上獲得 65 分，每百萬個輸入 Token 的成本為 0.042 美元。這篇文章 Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: 微軟完成 MAI-Base-2 預訓練：2.8T 參數碾壓開源對手，算力效率超 DeepSeek 數倍
items_all.summary: 微軟宣佈新一代SOTA基礎模型MAI-Base-2完成預訓練，官方稱其性能強於所有參測開源權重模型。該模型總參數2.8T、活躍參數80B，用6000塊英偉達GB200 GPU耗時38天訓成，平均浮點算力利用率21%、有效吞吐量89%。其在超大集羣上保持高效率，工程實力突出，算力效率更甩開DeepSeek 4至12倍，值得關注。

items_all.title: Meta 發佈 Muse Spark Open：自稱"美國最強開源"，兩臺 Mac Studio 就能跑
items_all.summary: Meta 15日發佈開放權重模型 Muse Spark Open，稱其爲迄今最強美國開放權重模型。該模型採用原生多模態架構，總參數816B、激活42B，上下文窗口達1M token，專爲代碼構建與智能體協作優化，在長程任務、複雜軟件工程和多步推理上表現突出。其本地部署門檻極低，依託MLX框架，成爲同級首個僅需兩臺搭載M5 Ultra芯片設備即可運行的模型。

items_all.title: 斯坦福等聯合提出全新文本生成範式 NCM，生成速度狂飆 31 倍
items_all.summary: 近日，斯坦福大學與Together AI聯合提出全新文本生成範式Next-Concept Modeling（NCM，即“下一概念建模”）。它顛覆傳統自迴歸和擴散模型，借鑑圖像生成中的“下一尺度預測”，模擬人類先構思宏觀大綱再逐步展開的寫作方式。該研究有望爲文本生成開闢新路線，文章重點介紹其創新背景、技術實現路徑及潛在影響。

items_all.title: Claude Opus5.5極速模式全面開放，輸出速度提升2.5倍
items_all.summary: Anthropic正式向全體開發者開放Claude Opus5.5極速模式，結束研究預覽並取消等待名單。該模式不削減模型權重或推理能力，通過優化底層配置將輸出速度提至標準模式2.5倍，並下調計費價格。目前僅支持部分Opus模型，開發者添加一行參數即可啓用。其設有獨立速率限制，不與標準模式共享提示詞。

items_all.title: Figma 推出 Markdown 編輯器 Specs，擴大代碼層公開測試
items_all.summary: Figma在印度首屆Config大會推出基於Markdown的新編輯器Figma Specs，並擴大代碼層公開測試，推進Payload與Figma Make集成，完善AI輔助設計與開發流程。Figma Specs支持以文檔定義設計語言，可獨立或與畫布共存，能引用畫布元素、嵌入FigJam圖表、代碼層和設計內容，並整合設計庫、代碼庫等資源。

items_all.summary: 路透社援引四名知情人士稱，AI融資成本攀升引發市場不安。Anthropic披露最新財務數據後，部分現有股東與擬參與IPO的投資者考慮下調其估值。三人透露，舊金山投資者日活動上，投資者圍繞約1.5萬億美元估值討論；此前預期其11月上市估值約2萬億美元。這顯示市場對AI高估值與融資環境趨於謹慎。

items_all.title: Google 正式上線“通用購物車”，深度打通搜索與 Gemini 購物體驗

items_all.title: Quoting Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang
items_all.summary: We think "did a human read the code?" is an imprecise proxy for "what could go wrong with this change, and which check—automated or human—is the right one to catch it?" Asking that question also changed when review happens. Before, review was a gate at the end of the road: write the code, open a PR, wait for your colleague. Now, review runs continuously, more like spellcheck while you write. Most changes have been reviewed and fixed by Claude at least once before a human is asked to look. This catches most routine mistakes, and saves team attention for higher-level questions and scrutiny. — Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang , How the Claude Code team does code review Tags: anthropic , claude , ai , claude-code , llms , addy-osmani , coding-agents , generative-ai , agentic-engineering , code-review

items_all_raw.summary: Apple's App Store rules now more explicitly ban so-called "nudify" apps that generate intimate images of people without their consent using AI tools. items_all_raw.summary: We think "did a human read the code?" is an imprecise proxy for "what could go wrong with this change, and which check—automated or human—is the right one to catch it?" Asking that question also changed when review happens. Before, review was a gate at the end of the road: write the code, open a PR, wait for your colleague. Now, review runs continuously, more like spellcheck while you write. Most changes have been reviewed and fixed by Claude at least once before a human is asked to look. This catches most routine mistakes, and saves team attention for higher-level questions and scrutiny. — Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang , How the Claude Code team does code review Tags: anthropic , claude , ai , claude-code , llms , addy-osmani , coding-agents , generative-ai , agentic-engineering , code-review

items_all_raw.summary: China plans to restrict exports of 23 key AI technologies, including model weights, source code, and training methods for systems hitting 10^26 FLOPs or 2 trillion parameters. A fast-track rule will still clear open-source releases as soon as they are registered, but the move will likely push Western companies to double down on US open-weight models over Chinese alternatives. The article China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 中國計畫限制 23 項關鍵人工智慧技術的出口，包含算力達到 10^26 FLOPs 或參數達到 2 兆的系統之模型權重、原始碼與訓練方法。一項快速通道規則仍將在開源版本註冊後立即予以放行，但此舉很可能會促使西方企業加倍押注美國的開源權重模型，而非中國的替代方案。這篇文章《China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies》首次發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months
items_all_raw.summary: Google Deepmind's Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, making Google the second lab after OpenAI to cross the 95 percent mark. But the results swing wildly depending on the test setup: in the standard harness, the score drops to just 49.8 percent. Argon also trails rivals in math and software engineering. The article Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 的 Gemini 4 Argon 在 ARC-AGI-3 基準測試中獲得 97.5% 的分數，這使 Google 成為繼 OpenAI 之後第二個突破 95% 門檻的實驗室。但測試結果會根據測試設定而大幅波動：在標準測試框架中，分數暴跌至僅 49.8%。Argon 在數學和軟體工程方面也落後於競爭對手。這篇名為《Google's Gemini 4 Argon 比數月來任何 Google 模型都更接近 AI 前沿》的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Is AI interpretability close to a breakthrough? A new essay has researchers divided
items_all_raw.summary: Neural networks may be much easier to read than researchers assumed, with about 90 percent of neurons serving a clear function. That would be big news for AI safety research, since deception or dangerous behavior could be spotted directly in a model's circuits. Researchers are still debating whether the thesis holds up. The article Is AI interpretability close to a breakthrough? A new essay has researchers divided appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 神經網路可能比研究人員原本假設的更容易解讀，大約有 90% 的神經元具有明確的功能。這對 AI 安全研究來說會是一大好消息，因為欺騙或危險行為可以直接在模型的電路中被發現。研究人員仍在爭論這個論點是否站得住腳。《AI 可解釋性是否接近突破？一篇新論文讓研究人員意見分歧》一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index
items_all_raw.summary: Liquid AI released d1-ultra, a text and image decision model that returns calibrated probabilities in 1 forward pass. It scores 65 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index and costs $0.042 per million input tokens. The post Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Liquid AI 發布了 d1-ultra，這是一款文字與圖片決策模型，能在 1 次前向傳遞中返回校準機率。它在 Artificial Analysis 決策指數上獲得 65 分，每百萬個輸入 Token 的成本為 0.042 美元。這篇文章 Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Meta 發佈 Muse Spark Open：自稱"美國最強開源"，兩臺 Mac Studio 就能跑
items_all_raw.summary: Meta 15日發佈開放權重模型 Muse Spark Open，稱其爲迄今最強美國開放權重模型。該模型採用原生多模態架構，總參數816B、激活42B，上下文窗口達1M token，專爲代碼構建與智能體協作優化，在長程任務、複雜軟件工程和多步推理上表現突出。其本地部署門檻極低，依託MLX框架，成爲同級首個僅需兩臺搭載M5 Ultra芯片設備即可運行的模型。

items_all_raw.summary: Figma在印度首屆Config大會推出基於Markdown的新編輯器Figma Specs，並擴大代碼層公開測試，推進Payload與Figma Make集成，完善AI輔助設計與開發流程。Figma Specs支持以文檔定義設計語言，可獨立或與畫布共存，能引用畫布元素、嵌入FigJam圖表、代碼層和設計內容，並整合設計庫、代碼庫等資源。
